material_findings.claim: PASS04's human-readable budget-unit mismatch and stop-threshold ambiguity are resolved.
material_findings.evidence: JSON and Markdown now share a current 45-minute / 12,000 generated-output / 500,000 provider-total contract. No current Markdown aggregate-token alternative remains. Cached input is included within input rather than added twice; output also has its own limit. At 80% used, 9,600 output, 400,000 provider-total or 36 elapsed minutes stops new modeling calls/dispatch, reserving 20% for QC/preservation/report. The historical ambiguous proposal is explicitly historical in JSON.
material_findings.consequence: A continuation reader can select one resource contract rather than approving one unit while workers execute another.
material_findings.next_test: T062 must validate actual provider counter semantics and log the chosen shared/per-worker allocations and clock against this single contract before dispatch.

material_findings.claim: The final plan makes remaining controller evidence explicit and does not claim operational dispatch readiness.
material_findings.evidence: T062 remains PROCESS_GAP_DOCUMENTED_NEXT_CONTROL_PROPOSAL. It requires a harmless drill, available counters, feasible suballocations, 60-second monitoring, outstanding/in-flight call allowance, cancellation latency and explicitly owned subprocess termination. Pending usage must be charged/estimated before further dispatch; unbounded pending cost or unavailable counters stops new work with a partial report. Cancellation may leave provider compute in flight, overshoot must be recorded, and no automatic overage or hard billing guarantee is claimed.
material_findings.consequence: An apparently precise cap could otherwise hide lagging counters, already running calls or a cancellation that does not halt provider work.
material_findings.next_test: Save actual counter baselines/semantics, selected-slice elapsed schedule including preparation, reserves, per-worker budgets, pending-call assumptions and harmless threshold/cancellation/counter-unavailable drill results. Until then report NOT READY FOR DISPATCH, not a failed artistic result.

material_findings.claim: The connected-head next selection is usable, and Markdown exposes the important dependency slices.
material_findings.evidence: Start at exact source/retained preflight and T062, then T001's owned plan/authority. Components require only that preflight slice; their finished head is not an impossible prerequisite. After integrated head construction, mandatory all-era eight views, whole-bird/head detail and successor-preservation pairs precede a scoped retain/reject/change direction decision. T012 stays provisional, and T020's later full-era finish/owner acceptance remains separate. Markdown prints both scope slices and restricted dependency edges. The graph has no cycles.
material_findings.consequence: The owner can choose a visible head-first follow-on without automatically authorizing a whole-product run or forcing full-era acceptance inside the short packet.
material_findings.next_test: Select exact owned tasks/slices in the assignment ledger; provide one whole-character comparison in 15–30 minutes and stop after two actual designs without visible gain or the resource ceiling. Obtain only the declared owner decision for that exact checkpoint.

material_findings.claim: Coverage and status counts support a comprehensive stage-aware inventory rather than an inflated list of fresh failures.
material_findings.evidence: All 62 task headings exist in Markdown and JSON. Independent extraction matches all 52 PRD criterion IDs, with F01–F10 retained. T029 is closed current delivery; T036/T038 are passing current-scope future maintenance. The other 59 entries include partial/unverified/conditional work and limited existing passes, not 59 newly failed or automatically authorized implementation tasks. Historical scores do not become current scores, and UNKNOWN/NOT RUN does not become observed failure.
material_findings.consequence: The reader can prioritize real next gaps and missing evidence without redoing closed delivery or treating every future requirement as a present defect.
material_findings.next_test: For a selected series, publish only selected slices with exact closure evidence/status transitions; preserve scoped passes and reopen only changed or stale evidence.

material_findings.claim: Surviving source, runtime and acceptance limits are visible at the final roadmap stage.
material_findings.evidence: Source goal remains UNMET and owner artistic acceptance PENDING. Retained breast/underlap/toe/crown progress is preserved while connected-head and era-finish gaps stay open. Static CG remains distinct from V37 and later animated acting/contact/inspection; human keyboard/screen-reader, physical devices, hardware performance and controlled representation remain separate evidence. Strict normal FAIL, shader/pixel parity UNKNOWN, private-preview route/counter limits and absent holdout remain disclosed. Mechanics/fitment is separately authorized future work, not a current appearance gate.
material_findings.consequence: Publication, a scoped direction decision or agent agreement cannot silently establish artistic, animated-product, physical or human acceptance.
material_findings.next_test: Close each remaining claim only against its exact applicable evidence and owner scope; any protected-holdout/uplift assertion must defer for evidence.
